activities.title: Oral Language Development: Community Circle Time
activities.content:
Greetings
• Welcome pupils and have them sit in a circle. 
• Say: En	fuɗɗorat	e	salmingol.	En	Salminirat	e	junngo	men	ñaamo.	Enen	fof	imminen	
junngo	men	ñaamo	to	dow.
• Check to make sure every pupil is holding up the right hand.
• Say: Kalawakktu mbo salmintaa neɗɗo, ndar mbo e yeeso noddaa innde mum, 
salminaaɗum.
• Turn to the pupil on your right, shake their hand.
• Say: (say the student's name). Jam waali (Haal inde janngoowo o) 
• Pupil should respond back saying "Good morning, teacher."
• Have the pupil that was just greeted, turn to the pupil on their right and greet them. 
This  continues all the way around the circle.
Theme Discussion
• Before school starts, bring in two items related to the theme to show the pupils. Put the   
items in the center of the circle. If no items are available, draw two pictures on the board  
instead.
• Say: Nde yontere, toɓɓere nde ko (NAAKO) kala ko woni ɗo na taawaa  e  tobbere nde.
• Hold up one of the items from the center of the circle. 
• Say: Ɗum ko hoɗum?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Fine Motor Development
• Say: Jooni	en	fortat	ɗaɗi	juuɗe	e	ɓalli	men	ɗii.	Ɗum	wallat	en	no	mbindirten.
• Exercise is marching: standing in place the opposite arm swings forward to the raised 
knee (left arm and right knee together). As pupils march on the spot, give orders: low 
march knees raised slightly), normal march (knees raised to half raised), high march 
(knees raised as high as possible), left turn, right turn, face forward.
• Alternative exercise is the crab walk: (make sure the ground is not dirty so pupils do 
not soil their clothes) sit on the ground with legs extended out in front, place hands by 
side	with	fingers	pointed	toward	feet,	lift	body	up	into	the	air,	start	moving	forward	or	
backwards. Have pupils try for one minute then have them stop and rest for a minute.    
 Then have them try again for another minute.

• Read the title of the story. Look at the illustration.

ko	fii	:		Mi	yi'i	suka	gorko	na	darii	takka	banaanayi	e	ndeer	ngal	natal.	Mi	sikki	ngol	taalol

remind them of the meaning of the word.

Alphabet Song
• Say: En	yimat	jimol	(maa	haalen	kelme	men	ɗe)	fii	kontinen	ekkitagol	no	winndirten	alkule	
ɗe	no	feewi	gooto	gooto.	
• Sing the alphabet song/chant: /a,	b,	c
• Yim jimol alkule limto pulaar.

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter "j" 'J'
• Say: Ko	alkulal	hoongal	jannguɗen	he	ndee	yonntere?
• Have the whole class answer.
• Say: Ko	hito	honngo	ngal	alkulal	waɗata?
• Have the whole class answer.
• Hold up the alphabet card for the letter. Point to the picture.
• Say: Ko	hoɗum	ngal	alkulal	/j/	daraanii?
• Have the whole class answer.
• Say: Yo gooto e mon okkam helmere jogiinde hito /j/.
• Call on 2 pupils at random to answer. After the response, affirm the correct answer or 
attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer.

lessons.homework:
(2 mins)
• Give each pupil a letter card and ask them to practice saying the letter name and sound 
with their family members.
• Ask learners to identify an object from their homes that starts with the letter sound of the 
day and report to class the next day.

activities.title: Vocabulary
activities.content:
Review and Discuss Words
• Words:  
 
ñawndoowo lekki
• Review the vocabulary words from the first story. Say the first word aloud, and have 
pupils repeat. 
• Say:	Muumno	miijoɗaa	helmere.	Ko	hoɗum	njiiɗaa?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer and ask if they remember what the word means. 
Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the 
definition. 
• Say: Mi	waɗɗat	helmere	e	ndeer	konngol.	Si	wonii	a	nanii	hoore	helmere	nde,	mem	hoore	
maa nde.
• Say: Baaba	yiino	ñawndoowo	o	hannde.
• Talk about ways to act out the word. 
• Say: Baaba	ndaaroyno	ñawndoowo	haŋki.  
• Say: Jooni en mbaɗat nate fii helmere nde.
• Talk about how the word can be drawn (object, use, etc.) and draw it on the board.
• Repeat all steps with the next word. For some words, call on a pupil at random to draw 
the picture of the word on the board.

activities.title: Reason to Read
activities.content:
Review Print Concepts
• Think about how we read a book. Show the cover.
• Say:  Ko hono janngirten defte?
• Call on a pupil at random to come and point to the book: top to bottom and left 
• Say: Ko	hono	ndaarirten	ɗeri	deftere?
· Call on a pupil at random to come and point to the book: front to back.

activities.title: Comprehension: Check
activities.content:
Factual Question: Who and What?
• Read the title of the first story this week. 
• Say: Ko	hoɓe	ngoni	he	ngol	taalol?	(Jaabawol:	Binta,Baaba,Neene,	ñawdoowo)
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.
• Say: Ko	huunde	wotere	honnde	ɓe	mbaɗata?	(Jaabawol:	Binta	mbo	faawaa,	Neene	e	
Baaba	noddi	ñawndoowo	o,	ñawndoowo	ari	galle	o	ñawndi	Binta,	Baaba	yehi	saare	o	
soodoyi	saŋke)
• Call on a pupil at random to answer. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know 
if it is correct, and clarify the answer. 
• Have the pupil point to the character in the story. Find the character's action in the story. 
• Have pupils act out the character's action(s) from the story.

(2 mins)
Ask learners to tell their family members about the story that was read in class today.
